hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook backed by Euler Protocol vaults. Swaps are fully handled in beforeSwap using a bespoke pricing curve (EulerSwap v1): input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault and output tokens are withdrawn from another, with a curve-invariant check enforced after each swap. Native Uniswap concentrated liquidity is intentionally disabled.
